title: Batman Returns
about: Batman takes on the Penguin and Catwoman at Christmas time.
cue: Serve the snacks when the Gotham Christmas tree lights up.
faces: "Long day at the office. Tonight I'm feeding myself first and the cats second, and that's the new order."
The lights dim at closing. Do keep together.
Dark rye fingers with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, capers and dill.
Chestnuts roasted until the shells curl, peeled warm and salted.
Crackling pork loin with roast potatoes and chunky sage apple sauce.
His lair under the Gotham Zoo.
Vanilla cupcakes with buttercream, a sugar tree and coconut snow.
Cold milk, vanilla and black tea shaken cold, with grated nutmeg and no alcohol.
